title: Format After Edit
summary: A Claude Code hook that runs Prettier on each file the agent edits, and quietly does nothing when the project has no Prettier installed.
description: Agent edits often drift from your formatting. This PostToolUse hook runs Prettier on the single file that was just written, so diffs stay clean without a separate formatting step.
It only acts when node_modules/prettier exists and the file type is one Prettier handles. In any other project it exits silently.
useWhen: Keep agent diffs formatted like your own code
Avoid a noisy format-only commit later
Work in a repo that already uses Prettier
Skip manual format runs after every edit

example.prompt: Add a retry helper to src/http.ts.
example.result: The helper is written, then Prettier rewrites src/http.ts with your quote and width settings. The diff shows no formatting noise.

faq.question: What if I have no Prettier?
faq.answer: Nothing happens. The hook checks for node_modules/prettier and exits quietly without it.

faq.question: Which files does it format?
faq.answer: JavaScript, TypeScript, JSON, CSS, HTML, Markdown, Vue, Svelte and YAML files.

access: Runs Prettier through npx on the edited file
